description: The street stays on the board

participation.context: Left the sheet, and did not buy the ink.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Had the copper on. She did not come up.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

story.body: You looked at Saturday's sheet and did not roll it. You left the glass in its cloth for the Jackdaw. You did not buy a horn of the ink.

title: Left Saturday's sheet at home and set the glass aside
